content:
## Newton's Second Law of Motion

Force equals mass times acceleration. This is one of the most fundamental equations in physics:

$$F = ma$$

Where:
- $F$ is the net force (in Newtons)
- $m$ is the mass (in kilograms)
- $a$ is the acceleration (in m/s²)

title: Newton's Second Law
content: The net force on an object is equal to the rate of change of its momentum: $\vec{F} = m\vec{a}$. This law explains why objects accelerate when pushed.
